events.title: Patch 0.96
events.summary: LumaEdge got a little faster!Moved to a new native build. The settings window feels snappier, and testing has shown better performance with the visualizer running.Fixed a startup issue that could prevent Luma from opening when its installation folder wasn’t writable.Cleaned up wording, tooltips, and naming throughout the app, cuz writer is not my favorite hat to wear!Same Luma, a little more zoom zoom. No additional tacos included!

events.title: LumaEdge Demo releases today!
events.summary: Demo Release is today!Every feature. No locked settings. Just some mildly annoying interruptions, too many tacos, and a 30-minute timer. Since Luma was envisioned, I always wanted it to be as available as possible, to as many people as possible. So, what better way to accomplish that goal, than by letting you try the whole thing! Luma's demo is therefore, fully unlocked. Its the full software suite. You can use every feature, make profiles (they should transition to the full release as well) SUB

events.title: LumaEdge 0.95 (Internal 4.5)
events.summary: LumaEdge 4.5 - I need more hands for all this stuff!This started with “hey, that dude on discord showed me a cool use case for Luma”.Then I broke DPI support, so I fixed that. Then the intro preset buttons broke, so i fixed that.Then my wife told me I should make Luma look prettier with her music....and now here we are! Meet the VisualizerLuma can now turn whatever’s playing through your speakers into animated bars across your overlays. Still Luma dynamic RGB gradients, so those visualizer bars

events.title: Patch 0.9 (Internal 4.0)
events.summary: LumaEdge 4.0: GOT OUT OF HAND!OK, so this update got slightly out of hand, lol.Since the last build, Luma Edge has gotten a full Cinema Mode, much better gradients, easier setup, faster performance, and a frankly absurd number of bug fixes.So, let’s get into it! CINEMA MODE!LumaEdge can now detect letterboxed, pillarboxed, and windowboxed content, then fill that unused space with reactive gradients.Basically, no more black bars!Well, technically the black bars are still there.
